title: Thorax
description: Described as a "beautiful city of the Sarabastrae" by Pliny the Elder, this ancient settlement may be identifiable with modern Tharad in the Indian state of Gujarat.

properties.description: Point digitized from raster of BAtlas map 6 that had been created and georegistered by the Ancient World Mapping Center. Dates from corresponding entry in BAtlDir.
